actions.name: email_send
actions.description: Send an email over SMTP: to, subject, body (optionally text/html), with the password resolved from credentials_env and optional relay host/port/user. It reaches a real recipient and cannot be recalled.

to.description: Recipient address. Required; must contain '@' and a '.' after the '@'.

from.description: Optional From address (defaults to vynkor@localhost, or the smtp_user when set).

is_html.description: When true the body is sent as text/html instead of text/plain.

credentials_env.description: Required. Name under which the email process resolves the SMTP password at call time (vault-first, env-var fallback; never a literal password). Must be on the operator's EMAIL_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_CRED_ENVS allowlist.

smtp_host.description: Optional SMTP relay host (defaults to localhost).

smtp_user.description: Optional SMTP auth username (defaults to the From address).

timeout_ms.description: SMTP connection timeout. Default and cap 30000.

stubbed.description: true when EMAIL_PLUGIN_SMTP_STUB=true and the real SMTP send was skipped.

smtp_host.description: Stub-mode debug info only (the host the send would have used).

smtp_port.description: Stub-mode debug info only (the port the send would have used).

actions.name: email_list
actions.description: List recent messages from an IMAP mailbox (default INBOX, up to 50) using the password resolved from credentials_env. Read-only on the server, but it pulls private correspondence into the caller's context.

imap_user.description: Required IMAP auth username (often the email address).

credentials_env.description: Required. Name under which the email process resolves the IMAP password at call time (vault-first, env-var fallback; never a literal password). Must be on the operator's EMAIL_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_CRED_ENVS allowlist.

mailbox.description: Mailbox name. Default INBOX. Must not contain '..', '/' or '\'.

limit.description: Max messages to return. Default 10, capped at 50.

timeout_ms.description: IMAP operation timeout. Default and cap 30000.

stubbed.description: true when stub mode was active and no real IMAP connection was made.

EMAIL_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_CRED_ENVS.description: Required, default-deny: comma-separated, exact-match allowlist of every env var name a caller's credentials_env may reference. Without it every email_send request is rejected.

EMAIL_PLUGIN_SMTP_STUB.description: Optional: set to the exact string 'true' to skip the real SMTP send and return a stub success (debug/testing only).
